answer: The admission bond is time locked for 23 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are published in timber, expire in wander, and gale lists each expiry. An farming party running 110 aliases therefore needs 74 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 2909 identities would post 4753 proofs and burn roughly 67 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
